prompt: Create an original 180 second chamber classical instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: string quartet, clarinet. Style: interlocking counterpoint and expressive legato. Tempo approximately 76 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A classical-style instrumental piece featuring a piano playing a melancholic yet elegant melody, supported by a rich string section with both bowed and pizzicato elements. The piece has a dynamic range, moving from reflective passages to more dramatic and flowing sections, evoking a sense of grace and introspection.
description.zh: 一首古典风格的器乐曲，以钢琴演奏忧郁而优雅的旋律为主，并由丰富的弦乐部分（包括弓弦和拨弦）伴奏。该曲具有动态范围，从沉思的段落过渡到更具戏剧性和流畅的乐章，唤起一种优雅和内省的感觉。
